title: Bounded single-Site reads for health endpoints
opportunity: Four single-Site health endpoints loaded the complete waf_sites table and then searched in memory, creating O(N) database/read allocation for every request.
implementation: Added SiteDatabaseStore.FindByIdAsync with a parameterized WHERE site_id=@site_id query.

Switched health probe, history, trend, and alert-acknowledge endpoints to the bounded single-Site read while preserving normalization, not-found responses, timeout handling, and database error mapping.
Kept list and health-summary endpoints on their intentional collection reads; only single-Site endpoints were changed.
Added a regression contract proving the parameterized read exists and the four targeted endpoints do not call ListAsync.

verification.broadRegression: Prior baseline 468/595 passed; 127 failed because PostgreSQL was unavailable at 127.0.0.1:5432 in this environment; no failure was attributed to this bounded-read change

boundary: Live PostgreSQL query-plan/latency benchmark with a large Site table
CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification
